summary: An adult heart with four chambers, valves, coronary vessels, the conduction system and pericardial sac. Named views expose the chamber interiors, SA and AV nodes, His bundle and Purkinje fibres. Enlarged wall and atrial teaching blocks show the pericardial layers, myocardium, endocardium, trabeculae and pectinate muscles.
scale_note: Gross heart and conduction system: 1 unit = 1 cm. Wall and atrial teaching blocks are enlarged 3 times, with exaggerated thin layers. Nodes and conduction strands are thickened for visibility; the pericardial fluid gap is enlarged to about 3 mm. Internodal paths represent preferential atrial muscle routes, not insulated tracts.

Conduction: Whole pathway, right heart o.note: The right atrium and ventricle are opened. Follow one beat: SA node (yellow) at the superior vena cava, the internodal pathways (pale yellow) to the AV node (orange), the AV bundle (green) through the fibrous skeleton, the bundle branches (blue) down the septum and the Purkinje fibres (violet) spreading from the apex.
